caption: The drawing features a decorative composition centered around a large, ornate vase or urn colored in light blue with accents of beige and ochre. The urn has a symmetrical, classical design and displays a ram's head at its center. Emerging from the urn is a bouquet of flowers, including several pink roses, red and blue blossoms, and green leaves, which are intricately detailed and spread outward in an arc. On either side of the urn, there are mirrored, stylized winged elements in gradients of red and pink with blue edges, each curling elegantly and ending in smaller floral motifs. Beneath the urn, there is a geometric pedestal featuring a blue and white color scheme, with a draped red cloth hanging down. The background of the drawing is a solid light yellow shade, framed by a light blue border. The overall design is symmetrical along the vertical axis.
title: Wall Painting
